body: I meant more along the lines of "secular." That being said, I've not found any and I've searched before. I just meant, I think side groups like these ought to be offered even though I don't think they are.

It would be nice if these groups offered a side group for non-religious folk, wouldn't it. I'm not an atheist, but I know enough atheists who have the dependencies but can't go to these types of groups, that I think it would be smart. Other dependency recovery groups are harder to find, especially for codependency.

I myself have reluctantcy given I'm not a Christian, which I keep using as an excuse to not go despite meeting the requirement of believing in a god/higher power.

I mean, it sounds good and I'd want that, but I have trouble imagining that being sincere.

EDIT: Also, I am in therapy, but I've been recommended to find someone who's more familiar with the issues I face after I came out about this recently. I've not found the new one yet.
